genericity_statement: Primitives are subject-wide Physics representation mechanisms. Motion, kinematics and dynamics enter only as render parameters extracted from P-A source questions and P-F structural obligations. No primitive is defined for a single topic.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Acceleration-time graph with labelled axes and a signed level on each interval.
primitives.attention_target: Level and sign of the plotted acceleration on each interval.
primitives.instructional_job: Show acceleration as a separately plotted quantity whose signed area is a change of velocity.
primitives.learner_action: Read the sign on each interval and say what it does to the velocity.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Bridge panel linking each symbol of the relation to the diagram feature it names.
primitives.attention_target: Which diagram feature each symbol in the relation refers to.
primitives.instructional_job: Connect each symbol in the relation back to the thing it names in the diagram.
primitives.learner_action: Point from each symbol to the feature it names before substituting a number.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Free-body diagram isolating one body with a labelled arrow for each acting force.
primitives.attention_target: Which forces act on the chosen body and in which direction.
primitives.instructional_job: Isolate one body and show every force acting on it as a directed arrow from the body.
primitives.learner_action: Name each arrow and check no force acting on another body has been drawn.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Two-case contrast panel in which exactly one physical feature differs.
primitives.attention_target: The single decisive feature that changes the answer.
primitives.instructional_job: Place the shortcut model and the correct model on two cases differing in exactly one feature.
primitives.learner_action: Predict both cases, then name the feature the shortcut ignores.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Model-validity gate listing each assumption with its stated, implied or absent marking.
primitives.attention_target: Each assumption of the selected model and whether the situation states it.
primitives.instructional_job: Gate the relation behind its assumptions so an invalid model cannot be used silently.
primitives.learner_action: Mark each assumption as stated, implied or absent before using the relation.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Strip of successive body positions at equal time intervals along the declared axis.
primitives.attention_target: Spacing between successive positions at equal time intervals.
primitives.instructional_job: Expose the body's successive positions at equal time steps so uneven spacing reads as changing speed.
primitives.learner_action: Compare successive gaps and say whether the speed is constant or changing.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Set of candidate graphs drawn on identical axes so one feature separates them.
primitives.attention_target: The single feature that separates the candidate graphs.
primitives.instructional_job: Put candidate graphs side by side so selection is a discrimination, not a guess.
primitives.learner_action: Reject each candidate by naming the feature it gets wrong.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Phase strip with boundary markers and the continuity state labelled across each boundary.
primitives.attention_target: The boundary instant and the state variables continuous across it.
primitives.instructional_job: Mark where the motion changes character and show which state is carried across the boundary unchanged.
primitives.learner_action: Copy the boundary state forward as the next phase's start state.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Scene showing the moving body, a fixed reference surface, and marked start and end positions.
primitives.attention_target: What moves, what is fixed, and what changes between the start and the end of the situation.
primitives.instructional_job: Show the physical situation before any symbol is written, so the learner reads events rather than a formula.
primitives.learner_action: Point at the object and say what physically happens, in order.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Position-time graph with labelled axes and a rise-over-run slope triangle.
primitives.attention_target: Slope of the plotted line and what the slope means physically.
primitives.instructional_job: Make position-against-time readable as a record of motion whose slope is a velocity.
primitives.learner_action: Build a slope triangle and state the velocity it gives.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Relative-frame view marking the frame body and the relative quantity between the two bodies.
primitives.attention_target: Which body the frame is attached to and what the relative quantity is.
primitives.instructional_job: Show two bodies and the quantity of one measured from the other.
primitives.learner_action: Subtract the frame body's quantity from the other body's before interpreting.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Signed axis strip marking the origin, the declared positive direction, and each signed leg.
primitives.attention_target: Where zero is and which direction has been declared positive.
primitives.instructional_job: Fix the origin and the positive direction, and show every signed quantity against that one convention.
primitives.learner_action: Re-sign every given quantity against the declared positive direction.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Decoder showing the same curve read once as a slope and once as a signed area.
primitives.attention_target: Whether the question asks for a rate or an accumulated change.
primitives.instructional_job: Separate the two different readings of one plotted curve: slope as a rate, signed area as a change.
primitives.learner_action: Choose slope or area before extracting anything from the curve.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Ruled state table with a start row and an end row and the unknown cell marked.
primitives.attention_target: Which quantity is known at which instant, and which is missing.
primitives.instructional_job: Hold the start state and the end state side by side so the unknown becomes visible.
primitives.learner_action: Fill both rows, then mark the one quantity the question asks for.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Timeline marking the bounding instants of the named interval and the span between them.
primitives.attention_target: The two instants bounding the named interval.
primitives.instructional_job: Make a named interval visible as the difference between two instants rather than a single time.
primitives.learner_action: Compute the quantity at each bounding instant and subtract.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Trajectory view drawing the travelled path and the straight chord between start and end.
primitives.attention_target: Path length against the straight start-to-end chord.
primitives.instructional_job: Separate the path actually travelled from the straight-line change of position.
primitives.learner_action: Trace the path, then draw the chord, and say which one the question asks for.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Vector state view with one labelled arrow per directed quantity at the named instant.
primitives.attention_target: Direction and relative size of each vector state quantity at a named instant.
primitives.instructional_job: Make each directed state quantity visible as an arrow with the sign the declared frame forces.
primitives.learner_action: Read each arrow's direction, then write it as a signed component along the axis.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Velocity-time graph with labelled axes and shaded signed area under the line.
primitives.attention_target: Slope of the line and the signed area beneath it.
primitives.instructional_job: Make velocity-against-time readable as slope for acceleration and signed area for displacement.
primitives.learner_action: Decide whether the question needs the slope or the area, then extract it.

primitives.accessibility_pattern: Verification strip with one tick box per required independent physical check.
primitives.attention_target: Which independent check has to pass before the answer is accepted.
primitives.instructional_job: Make the required physical check an executable step that can actually fail.
primitives.learner_action: Run each check and mark it only after it has actually been carried out.

realization_rule: A primitive is satisfied only by actual vector graphics. Every primitive declares a minimum_vector_ops floor that the renderer must meet with real line/rect/circle/path operations; drawing text labels alone fails TEACHING_PRIMITIVE_LABEL_ONLY_NOT_REALIZED.
subject: PHYSICS
